decision: Separate native classification from transferable semantic predicates; their ontologies need not correspond one-to-one.

native_final.population: official-clean-intent-v1 unchanged full learning and selection populations
native_final.input: Direct audio plus complete native category identifiers/descriptive names and an explicit dataset-classification instruction. Names are category descriptors, not certified necessary-and-sufficient semantic definitions.
native_final.output: one typed choice among all 60 categories
native_final.candidate_symbols: Output symbol and display-order changes require explicit category bindings; never omit or dynamically filter a candidate.
native_final.old_definition_cards: Historical drafts; do not supply contradictory boundaries as if native gold were guaranteed to satisfy them.
native_final.metrics: native accuracy, macro metrics, tail classes on fixed population; academic and clean protocols separate
native_final.scope: Dataset-label classification, not proof of semantic definition consumption or OOD detection

native_membership_control.question: Under this dataset's exclusive class convention, is the query assigned to the supplied category?
native_membership_control.role: optional redundant-classification control, not main independent semantic process evidence
native_membership_control.negative: Other native classes are negative for membership only, never for I_present.
native_membership_control.semantic_definition_variant: A question claiming an explicit semantic definition still requires validated definition-to-label mapping; this control does not waive that requirement.
native_membership_control.reward: No automatic process budget in semantic Q-credit; separate control configuration required

semantic_process.ontology: Independent task-level definitions of expressed communicative acts; may overlap and need not reproduce native classes.
semantic_process.population: All 40513 learning recordings retained, including cooking_query/general_quirky. Labels depend on evidence and definitions, not native membership.
semantic_process.non_request_policy: Greeting, preference and other communicative acts need explicit policies; request-only rules cannot negate these acts.
semantic_process.coverage: Finalize the full intended ontology and effective positive/negative supervision. Four contact/transport cards are rule studies, not a reduced final training task.
semantic_process.truth: Independent admitted semantic labels; old native labels and definition-fit proposals do not automatically become semantic truth.
semantic_process.missing: unavailable/conflict/unassessed mask reward and CE; keep population, no budget redistribution or implicit false
semantic_process.menu: Fixed panels or label-independent schedule; never selected using gold, reference text or predicted topic
semantic_process.final_relation: Shared-representation auxiliary evidence; no hard mapping or candidate filtering. Model reads Final directly in one forward; sampled preceding answers are not fed back.
semantic_process.all_false: Does not mean OOD or no intent; a finite panel is not an exhaustive semantic description

cooking_query.native: Retain both learning sources and the native class.
cooking_query.semantic: Do not invent a predicate defined by two source IDs. Recipe/preparation guidance can be expressed across native cooking classes; no label merge.
cooking_query.evidence: Both cooking_query references fit the historical recipe definition; motivates overlap, not automatic label admission.

general_quirky.native: Retain 425 learning sources/1550 recordings and native class.
general_quirky.semantic: No quirky semantic predicate, complement-of-known-predicates rule or OOD interpretation. Assess concrete requests/greetings/preferences/etc. individually under definitions; never assign all false from native membership.
general_quirky.evidence: Observed fragments, persona questions, factual/mathematical questions and requests do not define one closed semantic act.

experimental_arms.Direct: Native Final only; same native menu and supplied semantic knowledge as paired structured condition
experimental_arms.Q_input: Fixed I_present/S_present outputs and native Final; Final-only RL reward, fixed reported process CE
experimental_arms.Q_credit: Same input/action membership/CE/KL as Q_input; change only admitted process RL reward
experimental_arms.I_class_control: Separate optional redundancy control, never mixed into semantic process results
experimental_arms.knowledge: Same definitions across paired arms, no sample-specific omission of native classes
experimental_arms.status: panel sizes, coefficients and runtime not yet accepted

transfer.FSC_I_class: Protocol-v2 measures membership/control transfer; cannot prove same-I_present semantic transfer.
transfer.FSC_semantic: Publish I_present complete-command definitions and explicit target truth mapping, including location none and multi-request exceptions. Do not silently reuse native negatives. Define using TRAIN ontology; no TEST-feedback rewrite.
transfer.S_present: FSC attribute enums are not substitutes; preserve semantic-slot transfer on suitable datasets.
transfer.selection: Source selection only, predeclared Stage1/RL checkpoints, no target weight updates or feedback optimization

dependent_config_migration.menus: Old 60-I_class/55-S/15-panel schedule is historical. Derive new fixed menus after full semantic ontology freeze.
dependent_config_migration.stage1: Cannot inherit I denominator60. Recompute counts, schedule, weights and objective with admitted I_present ontology.
dependent_config_migration.reward: Retain fixed family-budget principle; bind I to I_present and publish coherent config before execution.
dependent_config_migration.context: Old all60 draft-definition probes do not validate native-menu-plus-semantic-definitions; processor/resource acceptance required.
dependent_config_migration.FSC: Protocol-v2 retained as membership track; same-operator semantic protocol pending.
dependent_config_migration.engineering: No trainer integration or research training before task package and dependent configs are complete.
